g: Grilling round 2 (2026-10-14): Town gold, prices, and the Kingdom Overview

q: Why there is a purse limit, and what to do instead. Towns earn Tax from their residents. Tax is new gold, and Towns had almost nothing to spend it on, so in the 4-hour test run purses kept growing: the richest Town held 128,000 gold (the "100k Towns" you asked me to fix on 2026-10-12). The limit (3,000 to 20,000 by Town level, residents spend the rest) was that fix. Which way instead?
ctx: Any of these keeps Towns from piling up 100k. Today a Town's gold only goes on buying Goods, level-ups (paid by you) and building.
o: No limit: the richer a Town, the more its residents spend each minute (for example 2% of the Purse per minute), so purses settle on their own instead of hitting a wall
No limit: Towns spend spare gold on their own growth (they level themselves up and upgrade buildings), so gold turns into a bigger Town
Keep the limit as it is
No limit and no fix: rich Towns may hold 100k+

q: Your new price range (0.25× to 5× base): is that the Town's whole asking price, or only the part from Sales pressure? Today the asking price is two parts multiplied: how much the Town has in Stock (0.4× to 1.9×) times Sales pressure (0.75× to 1.35×).
o: The whole asking price stays between 0.25× and 5× base, whatever the reason (Stock or Sales pressure)
Only Sales pressure goes from 0.25× to 5×; the Stock part comes on top

q: How fast should prices travel? A suggestion to react to: a Good that keeps selling reaches about 2× base after 5 minutes, about 3× after 30 minutes and about 4× after 2 hours, never 5×. A Good nobody buys falls to 0.5× after 5 minutes and 0.25× after about 1 hour.
Where does the price graph open? You asked for % change over 1 min / 5 min / 30 min / all time with buttons, and a price graph.
o: In the Town panel: each Good in the Stock list shows its % change for the chosen period; clicking the Good opens its price graph under it. The same buttons and graph also open from the Goods strip for the whole Kingdom's average price
Only from the Goods strip (Kingdom average)

q: How does the Kingdom Overview open? The design says K, but K opens the Castle today.
o: K and a Kingdom button in the top bar open the Overview; the Castle opens with C or by clicking it
A button only; K stays the Castle

q: The Overview's Town table (one row per Town, sort by any column, click a row to jump to the Town): which columns?
o: Town, level, people per tier, happiness, Purse, Tax per minute, Tariff per minute it brings the Crown, what it makes most, what it lacks (missing Basic Needs), alerts
A shorter set: Town, people, happiness, Purse, Tariff per minute, lacks

q: The Goods strip: a row along the top of the screen with one chip per Good. What's in it?
o: Only Goods the Kingdom has or makes; each chip shows the Good, the Kingdom's total Stock, the average price and a rising/falling arrow (over the chosen period)
All 26 Goods always, greyed when the Kingdom has none

q: Resource Flow: clicking a Good's chip shows on the map where it comes from and goes. What should it show?
o: Towns that make it (green ring), Towns that use it (orange ring), and lines along the trade routes it travelled in the last 5 minutes (thicker = more)
Only the Traders carrying it right now, highlighted

q: Alert icons over Towns (one at a time, the most urgent; clicking it opens the Town panel at the cause). Which alerts?
o: A workplace is idle (no workers or no inputs)
A building can't be finished: no Town sells a material it needs
